purpose: Nested tuning panels for grounding prompt development; not benchmark resplits or held-out validation.

selection_rationale.C041: Previously exercised short control; habitat access/animal controls.
selection_rationale.C037: Previously exercised typical control; wetland mitigation.
selection_rationale.C014: Previously exercised large control; table-bearing evidence.
selection_rationale.C001: Health risk; multiple required sections and main/appendix sources.
selection_rationale.C019: Groundwater/review; appendix-only evidence with optional context.
selection_rationale.C056: Drainage/flooding; main/appendix evidence with optional context.

slots: eligible edge variant selected for panel coverage
answer_selection.tie_break: Lexicographic variant ID after satisfying slot, excluding previously selected IDs; verify selected semantics and record fallback gaps before inference.
answer_selection.expectations: Restricted synthetic proposals, never grader input or calibrated gold.

user_review_stops: After small-Qwen dev6 or early model/infrastructure limitation, before larger-model stage
After larger-Qwen dev6, before full19 on either model

planning_access.limitation: Complete approved split proposal was JSON-decoded for metadata extraction; test-question fields were present in memory, though no question values were exposed or used.
